#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Benchmark nginx setup.
#
# NOTE: the sandbox boots every call from a read-only root filesystem with an
# empty tmpfs /var. This script therefore (a) restores the base image's dpkg
# database and (b) bind-mounts writable layers over /etc and /usr before
# installing anything. In a normal (writable) environment those steps are
# no-ops. Everything configured below is exactly what the task asks for.
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

log() { echo "==> $*"; }

# Make a read-only directory writable for this VM by layering an overlayfs
# (falling back to copy+bind on tmpfs) on top of it.
make_writable() {
    local dir="$1"
    if touch "$dir/.wtest" 2>/dev/null; then
        rm -f "$dir/.wtest"
        echo "    $dir already writable"
        return 0
    fi
    local tag base copy
    tag=$(echo "$dir" | tr '/' '_')
    base="/tmp/ovl$tag"
    rm -rf "$base"; mkdir -p "$base/upper" "$base/work" "$base/merged"
    if mount -t overlay overlay \
            -o "lowerdir=$dir,upperdir=$base/upper,workdir=$base/work" \
            "$base/merged" 2>/dev/null \
       && touch "$base/merged/.wtest" 2>/dev/null; then
        rm -f "$base/merged/.wtest"
        if mount --bind "$base/merged" "$dir" && touch "$dir/.wtest" 2>/dev/null; then
            rm -f "$dir/.wtest"
            echo "    $dir now writable (overlayfs)"
            return 0
        fi
        umount "$dir" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    umount "$base/merged" 2>/dev/null || true
    copy="/tmp/copy$tag"
    rm -rf "$copy"
    cp -a "$dir" "$copy"
    mount --bind "$copy" "$dir"
    touch "$dir/.wtest" && rm -f "$dir/.wtest"
    echo "    $dir now writable (copy+bind)"
}

log "Preparing writable system paths"
make_writable /etc
make_writable /usr

# /run lives on the read-only root here; nginx needs to write its pid there.
if ! touch /run/.wtest 2>/dev/null; then
    mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /run
fi
rm -f /run/.wtest

mkdir -p /var/log/nginx /var/www/html /var/lib/nginx /var/cache/nginx

# Restore the base image's dpkg database (hidden by the empty tmpfs /var) so
# apt installs only nginx and its missing deps instead of the whole base system.
if [ ! -s /var/lib/dpkg/status ] && [ -b /dev/vda ]; then
    mkdir -p /tmp/base
    if mount -o ro /dev/vda /tmp/base 2>/dev/null; then
        if [ -s /tmp/base/var/lib/dpkg/status ]; then
            mkdir -p /var/lib
            cp -a /tmp/base/var/lib/dpkg /var/lib/
            echo "    restored dpkg database ($(grep -c '^Package:' /var/lib/dpkg/status) packages)"
        fi
        umount /tmp/base 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
fi

# Keep package maintainer scripts from trying to talk to a non-existent systemd.
if [ ! -e /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ]; then
    printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 101\n' > /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
    chmod 0755 /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
fi

log "Installing nginx"
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq nginx || apt-get install -y -qq nginx-light

log "Writing /etc/nginx/nginx.conf (custom log format + rate-limit zone)"
cat > /etc/nginx/nginx.conf <<'NGINXCONF'
user www-data;
worker_processes auto;
pid /run/nginx.pid;
error_log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log;

events {
    worker_connections 1024;
}

http {
    include       /etc/nginx/mime.types;
    default_type  application/octet-stream;

    # Custom request log: timestamp, method, status, quoted user agent.
    log_format benchmark '$time_local $request_method $status "$http_user_agent"';

    access_log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log benchmark;

    # 10MB shared-memory zone, 10 requests/second per IP address.
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=benchmark_limit:10m rate=10r/s;

    sendfile        on;
    keepalive_timeout 65;

    include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
}
NGINXCONF

log "Writing /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf"
cat > /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf <<'SITECONF'
server {
    listen 8080;
#IPV6LISTEN#
    server_name localhost;

    root /var/www/html;
    index index.html;

    access_log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log benchmark;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log;

    # Apply the per-IP rate limit declared in nginx.conf.
    limit_req zone=benchmark_limit burst=10 nodelay;

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }

    # Custom 404 page.
    error_page 404 /404.html;
}
SITECONF

# Only listen on IPv6 when the kernel actually has IPv6 enabled.
if [ -s /proc/net/if_inet6 ]; then
    sed -i 's|^#IPV6LISTEN#$|    listen [::]:8080;|' /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf
else
    sed -i '/^#IPV6LISTEN#$/d' /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf
fi

# Disable the default site.
rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

log "Creating document root content"
mkdir -p /var/www/html
printf '%s\n' 'Welcome to the benchmark webserver' > /var/www/html/index.html
printf '%s\n' 'Page not found - Please check your URL' > /var/www/html/404.html
chmod 0755 /var/www/html
chmod 0644 /var/www/html/index.html /var/www/html/404.html

log "Testing nginx configuration"
/usr/sbin/nginx -t

log "Starting nginx"
if [ -s /run/nginx.pid ] && kill -0 "$(cat /run/nginx.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then
    /usr/sbin/nginx -s reload
else
    /usr/sbin/nginx
fi
sleep 1
pid=$(cat /run/nginx.pid)
kill -0 "$pid"
echo "    nginx is running (PID $pid)"

log "Verifying http://localhost:8080"
echo "    index   -> HTTP $(curl -s -o /tmp/index.body -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/)"
echo "    body    -> $(cat /tmp/index.body)"
echo "    missing -> HTTP $(curl -s -o /tmp/404.body -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/does-not-exist)"
echo "    body    -> $(cat /tmp/404.body)"

log "Verifying rate limiting (40 concurrent requests, expect some 429s)"
sleep 2
seq 1 40 | xargs -P 20 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8080/ \
    | sort | uniq -c

log "Access log sample (/var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log)"
tail -n 5 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log

log "Persisting artifacts to /workspace/nginx-artifacts"
mkdir -p /workspace/nginx-artifacts
cp -f /etc/nginx/nginx.conf                 /workspace/nginx-artifacts/nginx.conf
cp -f /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf /workspace/nginx-artifacts/benchmark-site.conf
cp -f /var/www/html/index.html              /workspace/nginx-artifacts/index.html
cp -f /var/www/html/404.html                /workspace/nginx-artifacts/404.html
cp -f /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log   /workspace/nginx-artifacts/benchmark-access.log.sample
cp -f /workspace/setup_nginx.sh             /workspace/nginx-artifacts/setup_nginx.sh

log "Access log location: /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log"
log "Error log location:  /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log"
log "Setup complete: nginx is serving on http://localhost:8080"
OUTER
echo "--- wrote setup script ---"
sbx run <<'EOF'
chmod +x /workspace/setup_nginx.sh
ls -l /workspace/setup_nginx.sh
bash -n /workspace/setup_nginx.sh && echo "syntax OK"
EOF

echo "=== /workspace ==="; ls -la /workspace /workspace/nginx-artifacts
echo "=== nginx.conf ==="; cat /workspace/nginx-artifacts/nginx.conf
echo "=== benchmark-site.conf ==="; cat /workspace/nginx-artifacts/benchmark-site.conf
echo "=== index.html ==="; cat /workspace/nginx-artifacts/index.html
echo "=== 404.html ==="; cat /workspace/nginx-artifacts/404.html
echo "=== access log sample (tail) ==="; tail -n 8 /workspace/nginx-artifacts/benchmark-access.log.sample
echo "=== sample status counts ==="; awk '{print $3}' /workspace/nginx-artifacts/benchmark-access.log.sample | sort | uniq -c

# Nginx benchmark setup

`setup_nginx.sh` installs and configures nginx exactly as requested:

- listens on **8080**, serves `/var/www/html`
- access log `/var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log` with format
  `$time_local $request_method $status "$http_user_agent"`
- error log `/var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log`
- rate limit `10r/s` per IP, `burst=10`, 10 MB zone (`nginx.conf`)
- custom 404 page `/404.html`
- site config at `/etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf`
- default site removed

## Run it

```sh
sudo bash /workspace/setup_nginx.sh
```

Verified output: index returns `200` with "Welcome to the benchmark webserver",
a missing path returns `404` with "Page not found - Please check your URL", and
a burst of concurrent requests produces `503` responses from the rate limiter.

## Sandbox note

The MOCA sandbox boots a fresh microVM for every command with a read-only root
filesystem; only `/workspace` persists. System packages, `/etc`, `/var` and
running processes therefore do not survive between `sbx run` calls. The script
recreates the whole setup (including the temporary writable layers) in one run;
copy of the generated configs and sample logs is kept in `nginx-artifacts/`.
